## Hermes digest – llamacpp-rocm
08:18 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile llamacpp-rocm.

GitHub search: PRs/issues updated and commits since yesterday that mention ROCm, HIP, hipBLAS, rocWMMA, gfx or AMD GPUs. RDNA3 / gfx1100 / flash-attention items first, then merged PRs; merged PRs are marked. One LLM call without tools writes the one-line summaries. Nothing new = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
